npcs.name: [NPC] Kestrel Consignment Steward
npcs.title: Kestrel Consignment House
npcs.dialogText: Welcome to the Kestrel Consignment House! Storage, teleport service, and the world map are all here. How may I serve you, adventurer?

npcs.name: [NPC] Potion Row Merchant
npcs.title: Potion Row Trader
npcs.dialogText: Fresh potions and traveller’s gear, brewed this morning! What can I get you?

npcs.name: [NPC] Master Blacksmith Ironhide
npcs.title: The Obsidian Smithy
npcs.dialogText: Clang! Welcome to the Obsidian Smithy. Bring me zeny and I’ll turn your gear into something the realms will remember.

npcs.name: [NPC] Elder Guide
npcs.title: Elder's House
npcs.dialogText: Welcome home, hero. The Whispering Meadows need clearing beyond the Rampart Gate — and Ordwin the Palisade Tyrant still holds the eastern tree line.

options.text: 📜 Accept Quest: Defeat Ordwin the Palisade Tyrant

npcs.name: [NPC] Barnacle Tavern Keeper
npcs.title: The Barnacle
npcs.dialogText: Ferry to the Sunken Sanctum leaves from the berth out back. Mind the Bilge Steps, too — some say they lead straight into the Silt Warrens if you know where to look.
